BC Conservative MLA Resigns from Caucus, Citing Leadership Issues

Linda Hepner, MLA for Surrey-Serpentine River, resigned from the BC Conservative caucus on Sunday. She criticized the party leadership's "willingness to listen" and described their actions as "beyond the pale."
